none: PAS KENT-0F37C5: Roman. Coin. Nummus AE2/3 House of Constantine. Obverse view.
contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

A complete, Roman, struck or hammered, copper alloy, nummus or AE2/3 of the House of Constantine. Obverse: Helmeted bust of Roma left. Inscription: VRBS ROMA. Reverse: She wolf left, suckling twins Romulus & Remus, two stars above. Inscription: None. Minted in Trier (Germany). Mint mark: -//TRP*. Reece period 17. Die axis: 12 o'clock. The coin is in very fine condition with slight wear otherwise an olive green patina but some surface corrosion and the edges a little nibbled . This coin is likely to date to 332-333AD. Ref. Coins of England and the UK, Spink 2009, page 62 no. 600, Identifying Roman Coins, Richard Reece & Simon James, Seaby 1986 reprint 1994, page 28-29 no. 93 & 94 and RIC…
